import os
import hashlib
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

filename = "alice_final_exam.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(filename):
    # Placeholder showing where the artifact metadata will be recorded
    artifact = {
        "filename": filename,
        "file_size_bytes": None,
        "sha256": None,
        "captured_at": datetime(2026, 10, 11).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "status": "Pending upload"
    }
    print("Submission Artifact Integrity Metadata (pending):")
else:
    file_size = os.path.getsize(filename)
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(filename, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
            sha256.update(chunk)
    artifact = {
        "filename": filename,
        "file_size_bytes": file_size,
        "sha256": sha256.hexdigest(),
        "captured_at": datetime(2026, 10, 11).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "status": "Captured"
    }
    print("Submission Artifact Integrity Metadata:")
    display(pd.DataFrame(list(artifact.items()), columns=["Field", "Value"]).to_string(index=False))

artifact_df = pd.DataFrame(list(artifact.items()), columns=["Field", "Value"])
artifact_df
